executiveSummary: One in three adults in our city has never had a library card. A pilot that put librarians in twelve laundromats issued 2,400 new cards in six months at a quarter of the branch cost. We ask the board to fund 200 outreach sites with 4% of the budget.

slides.slideTitle: Every library card is a key to a city
slides.subtitle: Libraries Forward 2026 · Opening keynote
slides.speakerNotes: - I want to start with a key. Not a metaphor yet. A plastic card.

slides.slideTitle: One in three adults in this city has never held one
keyBullets: adults in our city has never had a library card
slides.speakerNotes:
- One in three. In a city with 42 branches.
- That is the hook. Hold on to it.

slides.slideTitle: We built the branches and waited for people to come
slides.speakerNotes:
- For a century the model was: build it, stock it, open the doors.
- The people who never came, we called non-users. As if it were their failure.

slides.slideTitle: I didn't know the library was for people like me
keyBullets: I walked past it for nine years. I didn't know the library was for people like me.
slides.speakerNotes:
- Marisol said this the day she got her card, at a laundromat.
- Nine years.

slides.slideTitle: What if the library came to where people already are?
slides.speakerNotes: - This is the turn. Stop asking people to come to us.

slides.slideTitle: Twelve laundromats, six months, 2,400 new cards
slides.subtitle: The Pilot at Spin City laundromats
keyBullets: new library cards issued in six months at twelve laundromats
slides.speakerNotes:
- We put a librarian, a shelf, and a card table in twelve laundromats.
- 2,400 new cards. Most of them first cards ever.

slides.slideTitle: Waiting for visitors, or going where they are
slides.speakerNotes: - A quarter of the cost, seven times the reach.

slides.slideTitle: The people we reached were the ones we had missed
keyBullets: 38%: speak a language other than English at home
slides.speakerNotes: - These are exactly the one in three from the start of this talk.
slides.purpose: Closes the loop on the hook
slides.intent: Tie back to the one in three

slides.slideTitle: Getting from twelve sites to two hundred takes three steps
keyBullets: Partner: sign laundromats, clinics, and bus depots
Fund: $1.8M a year, 4% of the system's budget
slides.speakerNotes: - This is not a moonshot. It is three steps and 4% of the budget.

slides.slideTitle: Put 4% of the budget where people already are
keyBullets: Vote to fund 200 outreach sites in next year's budget
Name one partner site in your district by March
Send one librarian to the training in April
slides.speakerNotes: - Three asks. The first one is a vote in this room in January.

slides.slideTitle: Hand one in three their key
slides.subtitle: Vote for the outreach budget in January
slides.speakerNotes:
- Every library card is a key to a city. One in three of our neighbors has never been handed one.
- Let's hand it to them.
slides.intent: Leave the room moved to act
